description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing a 'Forgot Password' screen. It manages user input for email, interacts with an authentication provider to request password reset, and displays status messages and errors.

classes.name: ForgotPasswordScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents a form for users to input their email to reset their password.

classes.name: _ForgotPasswordScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the ForgotPasswordScreen' state, including user input, loading state, and message/error displays.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources like the email TextEditingController when the widget is removed.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validates email input, calls the password reset method, and updates UI with success or error messages.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the screen, including text input, messages, and submit button.
